entities.summary: Rabbi Shergill is an Indian musician well known for his debut album Rabbi and the chart-topper song of 2004, Bullah Ki Jaana . His music has been described variously as rock, Punjabi, with a bani style melody, and Sufi-style (sufiana), and "semi-Sufi semi-folksy kind of music with a lot of Western arrangements." Shergill has been called "Punjabi music's true urban balladeer".
